answer: Require every new agent to pass a propagation-thread quorum: five agents with no shared funder endorse it, each posting a 250 POA bond locked 60 days, 100% slashed on a proven duplicate. Each application faces a join puzzle, 6 hours of sequential CPU that cannot be parallelized, a jetty where bulk signups strand. The newcomer starts at zero, ivory ungraded and unpaid, paid only after three epochs of graded work, and a cluster sharing one funder that vouches for its kin loses every bond, so no haven for fakes can be bought. 1,000 fakes cost 250,000 POA and 6,000 CPU-hours.
